Test Story — Twilio Studio build sheet
============================================================

Widgets: 55 of 1000
Longest route: ~16 steps (cap is 1000 per call)

Rooms are ordered shallowest first, so working down this sheet means
descending the dungeon.

A dungeon loops, so some transitions necessarily point at rooms further
down the sheet. Those are marked (later) — drop the widget in now and
wire that transition once you reach its target, or place every widget
first and wire the whole flow afterwards.

Nothing in this flow is spoken by Twilio. Anything without a recording is
simply not emitted, so a room, round or refusal with no take is silence on
the phone. The audio manifest lists every one of them.

BEFORE YOU START — things to check:
  ! HALL digit 1: "Cold in the hand." is written for an item changing hands but has no recording, so the caller hears nothing at that moment.
  ! HALL digit 4 ("unwritten") is an unwritten branch — it has nowhere to go and is exported as a repeat.
  ! PANTRY: "A coin clinks." is written for an item changing hands on arrival but has no recording, so the caller hears nothing at that moment.
  ! PANTRY has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! CELLAR has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! DOOR has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! DOOR digit 1: "The key snaps off in the lock." is written for an item changing hands but has no recording, so the caller hears nothing at that moment.
  ! DOOR digit 1 refuses the caller with no recording, so they are sent back to the choices without being told why.
  ! VAULT has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! VAULT digit 1 refuses the caller with no recording, so they are sent back to the choices without being told why.
  ! VAULT digit 2 refuses the caller with no recording, so they are sent back to the choices without being told why.
  ! FIGHT has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! FIGHT round 1 has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before answering it.
  ! FIGHT round 2 has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before answering it.
  ! FIGHT round 3 has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before answering it.
  ! FIGHT: Round 3: pressing 3 (DUCK) leads nowhere yet.
  ! WON: "A coin clinks." is written for an item changing hands on arrival but has no recording, so the caller hears nothing at that moment.
  ! WON has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! DEAD has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! LOST has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! ESCAPE has no recording, so the caller hears nothing before the choices.
  ! A crowbar has no recording of its name, so a caller holding it hears nothing for it in the readback.
  ! There is no recording for empty hands, so a caller carrying nothing hears silence and is returned to the room.

─── CELLAR  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           CELLAR_d1_item
      # Heard as an item changes hands on digit 1.
      Play URL: audio/crowbar-gain.wav
      → audioComplete          : HALL_play  (later)

 2. Set Variables      CELLAR_d1_fx
      # Effects for pressing 1.
      inv = {% assign cur = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% unless cur contains "|CROWBAR|" %}{% assign cur = cur | append: "CROWBAR|" %}{% endunless %}{% unless cur contains "|CURSE|" %}{% assign cur = cur | append: "CURSE|" %}{% endunless %}{% unless cur contains "|CROWBAR|" %}{% assign cur = cur | append: "CROWBAR|" %}{% endunless %}{{ cur }}
      → next                   : CELLAR_d1_item

 3. Set Variables      inv_ret_CELLAR
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = CELLAR
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 4. Gather             CELLAR_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : CELLAR_keys
      → speech                 : CELLAR_keys
      → timeout                : CELLAR_gather

 5. Split Based On     CELLAR_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.CELLAR_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : CELLAR_d1_fx
      → Digits equals 2        : FIGHT_reset  (later)
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_CELLAR
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

─── DEAD  (ending, no audio yet) ────────────────
─── DOOR  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      DOOR_gates
      # All 4 gate(s) on this room, batched into one widget (§6.3).
      gate_DOOR_d1 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if inv contains "|KEY|" or inv contains "|CROWBAR|" %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      gate_DOOR_d2 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% assign v_COINS = flow.variables.c_COINS | default: 0 %}{% if v_COINS >= 2 and v_COINS <= 3 %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      gate_DOOR_d3 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if inv contains "|LAMP|" %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      gate_DOOR_d4 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if inv contains "|CURSE|" == false and inv contains "|KEY|" == false %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      → next                   : DOOR_gather

 2. Set Variables      DOOR_d1_spend
      # Spend whichever of KEY / CROWBAR opened this — only the one.
      inv = {% assign cur = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% assign spent = false %}{% if cur contains "|KEY|" and spent == false %}{% assign cur = cur | replace: "|KEY|", "|" %}{% assign spent = true %}{% endif %}{% if cur contains "|CROWBAR|" and spent == false %}{% assign cur = cur | replace: "|CROWBAR|", "|" %}{% assign spent = true %}{% endif %}{{ cur }}
      → next                   : VAULT_fx  (later)

 3. Split Based On     DOOR_d1_gate
      # Gate on digit 1; the boolean was computed in DOOR_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_DOOR_d1}}
      → Equal To pass          : DOOR_d1_spend
      → noMatch                : DOOR_gather

 4. Split Based On     DOOR_d2_gate
      # Gate on digit 2; the boolean was computed in DOOR_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_DOOR_d2}}
      → Equal To pass          : WON_fx  (later)
      → noMatch                : DOOR_d2_refuse

 5. Say/Play           DOOR_d2_refuse
      # Refusal. Returns to the GATHER, not the play widget, so the caller doesn't re-hear the whole scene. Route the 8th attempt to an escape.
      Play URL: audio/poor.wav
      → audioComplete          : DOOR_gather

 6. Split Based On     DOOR_d4_gate
      # Gate on digit 4; the boolean was computed in DOOR_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_DOOR_d4}}
      → Equal To pass          : (nowhere)
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 7. Say/Play           DOOR_d4_react
      # Reaction to pressing 4.
      Play URL: audio/hinges.wav
      → audioComplete          : DOOR_d4_gate

 8. Set Variables      inv_ret_DOOR
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = DOOR
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 9. Gather             DOOR_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : DOOR_keys
      → speech                 : DOOR_keys
      → timeout                : DOOR_gather

 10. Split Based On     DOOR_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.DOOR_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : DOOR_d1_gate
      → Digits equals 2        : DOOR_d2_gate
      → Digits equals 3        : HALL_play  (later)
      → Digits equals 4        : DOOR_d4_react
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_DOOR
      → noMatch                : DOOR_gather

─── ESCAPE  (ending, no audio yet) ────────────────
─── FIGHT  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Gather             FIGHT_r1_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=DUCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : FIGHT_r1_keys
      → speech                 : FIGHT_r1_keys
      → timeout                : FIGHT_r1_waited

 2. Split Based On     FIGHT_r1_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.FIGHT_r1_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : FIGHT_r2_gather
      → Digits equals 2        : (nowhere)
      → Digits equals 3        : (nowhere)
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 3. Set Variables      FIGHT_r1_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      FIGHT_r1_silence = {{ flow.variables.FIGHT_r1_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : FIGHT_r1_patience

 4. Split Based On     FIGHT_r1_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 2 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.FIGHT_r1_silence}}
      → Less than 2            : FIGHT_r1_gather
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 5. Gather             FIGHT_r2_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=DUCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : FIGHT_r2_keys
      → speech                 : FIGHT_r2_keys
      → timeout                : FIGHT_r2_waited

 6. Split Based On     FIGHT_r2_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.FIGHT_r2_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : (nowhere)
      → Digits equals 2        : FIGHT_r3_gather
      → Digits equals 3        : (nowhere)
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 7. Set Variables      FIGHT_r2_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      FIGHT_r2_silence = {{ flow.variables.FIGHT_r2_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : FIGHT_r2_patience

 8. Split Based On     FIGHT_r2_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 2 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.FIGHT_r2_silence}}
      → Less than 2            : FIGHT_r2_gather
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 9. Gather             FIGHT_r3_gather
      # 1=PUNCH, 2=KICK, 3=DUCK. Any other digit, and silence, takes the losing route.
      → keypress               : FIGHT_r3_keys
      → speech                 : FIGHT_r3_keys
      → timeout                : FIGHT_r3_waited

 10. Split Based On     FIGHT_r3_keys
      # Which move the caller answered with.
      Split on: {{widgets.FIGHT_r3_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : WON_fx  (later)
      → Digits equals 2        : (nowhere)
      → Digits equals 3        : FIGHT_reset
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 11. Set Variables      FIGHT_r3_waited
      # The caller said nothing. Count it.
      FIGHT_r3_silence = {{ flow.variables.FIGHT_r3_silence | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : FIGHT_r3_patience

 12. Split Based On     FIGHT_r3_patience
      # Repeat the round up to 2 times, then the fight is called.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.FIGHT_r3_silence}}
      → Less than 2            : FIGHT_r3_gather
      → noMatch                : (nowhere)

 13. Set Variables      FIGHT_reset
      # Clear the silence counters, so re-entering this fight starts fresh.
      FIGHT_r1_silence = 0
      FIGHT_r2_silence = 0
      FIGHT_r3_silence = 0
      → next                   : FIGHT_r1_gather

─── HALL  (room, recorded) ────────────────
 1. Say/Play           HALL_play
      # Play the recorded audio. — Carter
      Play URL: audio/line-HALL-0.mp3
      → audioComplete          : HALL_line2

 2. Say/Play           HALL_line2
      # Play the recorded audio. — Mike
      Play URL: audio/line-HALL-1.mp3
      → audioComplete          : HALL_line3

 3. Say/Play           HALL_line3
      # Play the recorded audio.
      Play URL: audio/line-HALL-2.mp3
      → audioComplete          : HALL_gather

 4. Set Variables      HALL_d1_fx
      # Effects for pressing 1.
      inv = {% assign cur = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if cur contains "|KEY|" %}{{ cur }}{% else %}{{ cur }}KEY|{% endif %}
      → next                   : PANTRY_fx  (later)

 5. Set Variables      inv_ret_HALL
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = HALL
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 6. Gather             HALL_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : HALL_keys
      → speech                 : HALL_keys
      → timeout                : HALL_play

 7. Split Based On     HALL_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.HALL_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : HALL_d1_fx
      → Digits equals 2        : CELLAR_gather
      → Digits equals 3        : DOOR_gates
      → Digits equals 4        : HALL_gather
      → Digits equals 5        : HALL_play
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_HALL
      → noMatch                : HALL_play

─── LOST  (ending, no audio yet) ────────────────
─── PANTRY  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      PANTRY_fx
      # Arrival effects — fire before the room is described.
      inv = {% assign cur = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if cur contains "|LAMP|" %}{{ cur }}{% else %}{{ cur }}LAMP|{% endif %}
      c_COINS = {{ flow.variables.c_COINS | default: 0 | plus: 1 }}
      → next                   : PANTRY_gather

 2. Set Variables      inv_ret_PANTRY
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = PANTRY
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 3. Gather             PANTRY_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : PANTRY_keys
      → speech                 : PANTRY_keys
      → timeout                : HALL_play

 4. Split Based On     PANTRY_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.PANTRY_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : HALL_play
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_PANTRY
      → noMatch                : PANTRY_gather

─── VAULT  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      VAULT_fx
      # Arrival effects — fire before the room is described.
      c_COINS = 0
      → next                   : VAULT_gates

 2. Set Variables      VAULT_gates
      # All 2 gate(s) on this room, batched into one widget (§6.3).
      gate_VAULT_d1 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% assign v_COINS = flow.variables.c_COINS | default: 0 %}{% if v_COINS == 0 %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      gate_VAULT_d2 = {% assign inv = flow.variables.inv | default: "|" %}{% if true %}pass{% else %}fail{% endif %}
      → next                   : VAULT_gather

 3. Split Based On     VAULT_d1_gate
      # Gate on digit 1; the boolean was computed in VAULT_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_VAULT_d1}}
      → Equal To pass          : (nowhere)
      → noMatch                : VAULT_gather

 4. Split Based On     VAULT_d2_gate
      # Gate on digit 2; the boolean was computed in VAULT_gates.
      Split on: {{flow.variables.gate_VAULT_d2}}
      → Equal To pass          : HALL_play
      → noMatch                : VAULT_gather

 5. Set Variables      inv_ret_VAULT
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = VAULT
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 6. Gather             VAULT_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : VAULT_keys
      → speech                 : VAULT_keys
      → timeout                : VAULT_gather

 7. Split Based On     VAULT_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.VAULT_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : VAULT_d1_gate
      → Digits equals 2        : VAULT_d2_gate
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_VAULT
      → noMatch                : VAULT_gather

─── WON  (room, no audio yet) ────────────────
 1. Set Variables      WON_fx
      # Arrival effects — fire before the room is described.
      inv = {{ flow.variables.inv | replace: "|CURSE|", "|" }}
      c_COINS = {{ flow.variables.c_COINS | default: 0 | plus: 5 }}
      → next                   : WON_gather

 2. Set Variables      inv_ret_WON
      # Remember where to come back to, then read the satchel back.
      ret = WON
      → next                   : inv_start  (later)

 3. Gather             WON_gather
      # Stop gathering after 1 digit; 5s timeout.
      → keypress               : WON_keys
      → speech                 : WON_keys
      → timeout                : WON_gather

 4. Split Based On     WON_keys
      # Which key was pressed. Anything unlisted is a wrong keypress.
      Split on: {{widgets.WON_gather.Digits}}
      → Digits equals 1        : HALL_play
      → Digits equals #        : inv_ret_WON
      → noMatch                : WON_gather


PATIENCE VALVE
Studio stops an execution if the same widget runs 10 times in a row, so a caller
mashing a locked door gets hung up on. Route the 8th consecutive refusal to an
escape node instead of back to the gather.
